_note: direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing here was guessed. A feed URL that cannot be tested is not added,
because an untested guess reports itself unreachable on every harvest and
quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches. The URL is built by the harvester from
hl / gl / ceid, so these need no separate verification. Queries rotate so
the whole subject range is covered rather than one theme repeated.
events: subject searches for the institutions and companies the School
section names but which have no verified feed in this build — UNESCO, the
Global Partnership for Education, the publishers, the private equity owners.
official  ministries, inspectorates, courts, UN bodies, the OECD, the World Bank
research  institutes, education data, investigative research
press     general news across the locales
rights    unions, privacy and campaigning organisations
To add a source: put it in direct with a feed URL you have actually opened.
